current_metrics.methodology_label:
Same-country linker real-yield curve spread between two
real-yield tenors of the same sovereign linker curve (e.g.
USD_TIPS 5s10s real-yield, GBP_LINKER 2s10s real-yield,
EUR_FR_LINKER 5s10s real-yield, CAD_RRB 5s30s real-yield).
Computed per-trade-date via the SPREAD formula:

  spread_pct = long_real_yield_pct - short_real_yield_pct

where ``short_real_yield_pct`` and ``long_real_yield_pct`` are
the linker real-yield levels at ``short_tenor`` and
``long_tenor`` respectively (each computed by
``get_real_yield_level`` filtered by
``instrument_type='inflation_linker'`` AND ``curve_family=?``
AND ``tenor=?`` AND ``field_name=?`` — the no-proxy guard
inherited transitively).  The two endpoint series are aligned
per-trade-date via a strict pandas inner-join on calendar
trade_date AFTER each is computed independently; the spread
is computed only on dates where BOTH endpoints exist (no
synthetic spread points are produced).

Same-country / same-curve-family construction only: the input
layer accepts a single linker ``curve_family`` field so cross-
curve combinations cannot be expressed.  Compute additionally
re-asserts that the resolved instrument_master rows for that
curve_family map to a single (country, currency) tuple under
``instrument_type='inflation_linker'`` (a defensive guard
against an instrument_master inconsistency), surfacing a
controlled error envelope on mismatch.

The output is the term structure of REAL YIELDS (real-yield
curve shape), distinct from a breakeven curve spread (which
differences two inflation-compensation pairs) and from a
nominal sovereign curve spread (which differences two nominal
yields).  Real yields are quoted in PERCENT and the spread is
reported in PERCENT — same units as the underlying.  Daily /
weekly / monthly *changes* of the spread are reported in BPS,
matching the desk convention for change reporting on any rate
level.

time_series_spread.description: Same-country linker real-yield curve spread for USD_TIPS (10Y/30Y; long_real_yield_pct - short_real_yield_pct) over the displayed window.  Term structure of REAL YIELDS for (US, USD) linkers — distinct from a breakeven curve spread (inflation compensation) and from a nominal sovereign curve spread.  Quoted in PERCENT (same units as the underlying real yields).

time_series_zscore.description: Rolling z-score of the USD_TIPS real-yield curve spread (in PERCENT) over 10Y/30Y vs its own trailing window.
